articles.summary: Blast at major Syrian pipeline halts gas flow, disrupts power generation An explosion to a major pipeline in north eastern Syria has put a stop to gas flow from the Al-Jabsah gas plant, the Syrian Petroleum Company (SPC) said.  This has resulted in the disruption of supplies to a number of power generation turbines. No workers in the area were reported injured in the blast.  SPC said that preliminary investigations indicated that the explosion was caused by a "deliberate act of sabotage", and added that authorities will continue to examine and work on identifying culprits.
